verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
NSANYUKIRA-oluyimba
Lwa bamalayika
Lwe baayimba okulanga
Okujja kwa Yesu.
Nze sirina bulungi,
Nnina-ebibi bingi;
Naye yakka ku lwange
Yesu Mulokozi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mmanyi Mukama waffe
Yafuuka omuto,
-Okulaga empisa ennungi
Ffe tuzikwatenga
Era bwe naafubanga
Okumufaanana
Ye tanneerabirenga,
Kubanga-anjagala.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Siyinza kumulaba
Kaakano n'amaaso
Naye ennyimba zange
Anaaziwwulira.
Bwe naamugonderanga,
Alintuusa-ewuwe
Ne mutenderezanga
Nga bwe kisaanidde.
